purpose: Prevent repeated claim audits by indexing existing merged and unmerged editorial reviews against the exact current canonical owners, without exaggerating their approval levels.

definitions.four_role_screen: Read existing English text and recorded citations / limited source excerpts; NOT complete claim-by-claim independent source verification, bilingual approval or public release.
definitions.original_context_finding: Bounded inspection of a named original document in a prior merged audit; not blanket approval of the entire source-linked section.
definitions.legacy_gate: Historical case-specific QA or actual original-text spot check belonging to a separate historical research record, not automatic certification of a canonical synthesis.
definitions.not_in_this_index: A reviewer/screening assessment may exist in another specialist pipeline; absence from this limited reconciling register is not evidence the claim was never checked.
definitions.status_policy: Do not treat an arbitrary new ledger's NOT_CHECKED field as prior absence. Preserve earlier corrections and blocked/incomplete annotations before considering new research.
